expeditions.title: See the market before you commit to it.
expeditions.sub: Small-group trips to Pakistan, India, the Philippines and the UAE — and the other way, to the factories of Guangzhou, Dongguan and Shenzhen. We plan it, take you round, translate, and stay with you until you fly home.

types.d: Dated editions for 8–12 manufacturers and brand owners. Retail clusters, distributors, regulators and a debrief.
A private trip for you and your team, built around your product, your dates and the meetings that matter to you.
For individuals and small teams who want one city, one channel or one question answered on the ground.
For buyers from Pakistan, India, the Philippines and the UAE: the Canton Fair, factory visits and sourcing meetings.

expeditions.travelTitle: You fly in. We handle the rest.

travel.d: Invitation letters and guidance for every traveller.
Booked near the markets you are there to see.
Airport transfers and a car with a driver for every day on the ground.
Urdu, Hindi, Filipino, Arabic and Mandarin.
One person who knows the plan and answers the phone.
Distributors, dealers, regulators and partners booked before you land.

labels.note: Dates, itineraries and prices are confirmed with each edition. Seats are offered after a short application.

included: Airport pick and drop, and daily transport
Every meeting and briefing on the itinerary
A written debrief and next-step plan

editions.title: Pakistan market trip: Karachi and Lahore
editions.one: Five days in the two cities that set the price for the whole country.
editions.for: Manufacturers and brand owners in electronics, accessories, solar and appliances planning a first shipment to Pakistan.
days: Arrival, market briefing and dinner with the team.
Saddar mobile and electronics markets on foot; lunch with dealers.
Distributor and warehouse visits; customs and PSQCA briefing.
Fly to Lahore; Hafeez Centre and Hall Road; dealer meetings.
One-to-one meetings, debrief and next steps; departures.

editions.title: India market trip: Delhi and Patna
editions.one: A national hub and a regional market — and why winning one is not winning the other.
editions.for: Brands preparing BIS registration and a distributor-led launch in North and East India.
days: Arrival, market briefing and dinner with the team.
Gaffar Market and Nehru Place electronics clusters; distributor lunch.
BIS and import briefing; national distributor meetings.
Fly to Patna; retail clusters and dealer visits.
Regional distributor meetings, debrief and next steps; departures.

editions.title: Philippines market trip: Manila
editions.one: Malls, sari-sari stores and live selling — three channels in one city.
editions.for: Brands weighing retail chains against marketplaces and social commerce in the Philippines.
days: Arrival, market briefing and dinner with the team.
Divisoria and Greenhills on foot; mall retail and national chains.
Warehouse and last-mile partners; Lazada, Shopee and live-selling briefing.
One-to-one meetings, debrief and next steps; departures.

editions.title: UAE market trip: Dubai
editions.one: Marketplaces, re-export traders and the free zones that open the wider region.
editions.for: Brands entering the GCC through Amazon.ae, Noon and Dubai's re-export trade.
days: Arrival; Deira wholesale markets and re-export traders.
Amazon.ae and Noon operations briefing; Dragon Mart; retail chains.
Free-zone and company set-up briefing, debrief and next steps; departures.

editions.title: Canton Fair and factory trip: Guangzhou, Dongguan, Shenzhen
editions.one: The reverse trip — for buyers who want to source with someone who knows the factories.
editions.for: Distributors, retailers and creators from Pakistan, India, the Philippines and the UAE sourcing from China.
days: Arrival and sourcing briefing; dinner with the team.
Canton Fair: halls chosen for your categories, with an interpreter.
Canton Fair and supplier meetings; samples and price checks.
Huaqiangbei electronics market, debrief and next steps; departures.
